calls.title: Jake / Chris - sync on workflow, Apollo, etc.
calls.summary: The meeting covered enhancements to the sales prospecting process through the use of Sales Navigator and Apollo for targeted outreach. Jake Stangl curates lead lists while collaborating with AEs and leadership to ensure alignment with ideal customer profiles. Current practices for contact and account ownership are evolving, with inconsistencies noted in HubSpot, where many accounts lack clear owners. Improvements in the synchronization of account and contact ownership are highlighted. The use of Rio for identifying company interest was discussed, acknowledging its limitations in individual visitor data. Manual processes for scheduling meetings and deal tracking are functional but recognized as barriers to scalability, prompting discussions around future automation and data-driven prioritization to improve the outreach process.
calls.keywords: Sales Navigator, Apollo, HubSpot, Account ownership, Rio surge signals, Lead enrichment
calls.action_items:
**Jake Stangl**
Continue gathering targeted prospect lists using LinkedIn Sales Navigator and import them into Apollo for enrichment and outreach sequencing (00:01)
Check and update account ownership in HubSpot as meetings are assigned to ensure accurate pipeline tracking and ownership (17:33)
Collaborate bi-weekly with Account Executives (AEs) to align accounts and campaigns; send meetings to Ryan for round-robin AE assignment (13:24)
Create deals manually in HubSpot after scheduling meetings and assign AE owners as instructed to maintain accurate pipeline data (14:51)
Use Rio surge data to identify companies showing increased interest, research contacts in Sales Navigator, and import them into Apollo for outreach (08:25)

**Chris Newton**
Coordinate and support cleanup of account ownership in HubSpot, removing owners of inactive or departed employees to maintain data accuracy (16:08)
Develop a HubSpot dashboard or task list to alert Jake about surging accounts, filtering by company size and visitor data for prioritization (08:25)
Investigate tools and workflows to improve automation of AE assignment and integration between HubSpot and Apollo for smoother lead handoff (12:54)
Monitor deal ownership and pipeline cleanup to assign stale or orphaned opportunities to active representatives for potential re-engagement (06:56)
